name: leotiger/lingua-forge-dev
description: Dev tooling for the Lingua Forge WordPress plugin. The plugin source lives in the parent ../  directory and ships with zero runtime Composer dependencies — this dev/ folder holds vendor/, and every linter/test config. Nothing here ever reaches WordPress.org.

scripts.test:integration: ./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'cd /var/www/html/dev-tools && php vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist --testsuite=integration'
plugin-check: ./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run cli wp plugin install plugin-check --activate || true
./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run cli wp plugin check lingua-forge

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHPCS against ../ using WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the subset of PHPCS issues phpcbf can fix.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan with the WordPress stub set against ../.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full PHPUnit suite (unit + integration).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run only the unit suite (no WordPress required).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run only the integration suite (requires wp-env running).
scripts-descriptions.plugin-check: Run the official WordPress Plugin Check tool inside wp-env.
scripts-descriptions.qa: Local pre-deploy gate: lint → analyse → unit tests. Integration tests require wp-env and must be run separately with composer test:integration.
scripts-descriptions.make-pot: Regenerate languages/lingua-forge.pot. Downloads wp-cli.phar to dev/ on first run (curl + php required); no Docker or global WP-CLI needed.
